The '''Andorra national futsal team''' is controlled by the [[Andorran Football Federation]], the governing body for futsal in [[Andorra]] and represents the country in international [[futsal]] competitions, such as the [[FIFA Futsal World Cup|World Cup]] and the [[UEFA Futsal Championship|European Championships]].
